description: This is a test source file for OrderSetService in the OpenMRS API project. It contains unit tests for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting OrderSet and OrderSetMember objects, as well as testing related attribute types.

classes.name: OrderSetServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OrderSetService, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to utilize OpenMRS testing infrastructure.

methods.name: shouldSaveOrderSet
methods.description: Tests saving a new OrderSet and confirms it increases the total count.

methods.name: shouldSaveAndUpdateOrderSet
methods.description: Tests saving and updating properties of an existing OrderSet.

methods.name: shouldRetrieveOrderSetMembersOfAnOrderSet
methods.description: Verifies that OrderSetMembers are correctly retrieved for an OrderSet.

methods.name: shouldNotAutomaticallyPropagateToSetMembersIfExcludingOrderSet
methods.description: Ensures order set members are not propagated when excluding order sets.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberAtLastPositionInsideAnExistingOrderSetIfPositionIsNull
methods.description: Tests adding a new member at the end of an OrderSet when position is null.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberAtSomePositionInsideAnExistingOrderSet
methods.description: Tests inserting a new member at a specific position within an OrderSet.

methods.name: shouldReturnInTheSameArrangementInWhichTheOrderSetMembersAreSaved
methods.description: Checks that the order of OrderSetMembers is preserved after saving.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberFromTheEndOfTheListIfNegativePositionIsGiven
methods.description: Verifies behavior when adding a member with a negative index (appended at the end).

methods.name: shouldFetchUnRetiredOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Ensures retired members are excluded when fetching active members.

methods.name: shouldDeleteAnOrderSetMemberInAnOrderSet
methods.description: Tests removal of an OrderSetMember from an OrderSet.

methods.name: shouldFetchOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Confirms retrieval of OrderSetMember by UUID.

methods.name: shouldRetireOrderSetAndOrderSetMembersAsWell
methods.description: Tests retiring an OrderSet and its members, marking them as retired.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid_shouldGetTheOrderSetAttributeWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving OrderSetAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoOrderSetAttributeHasTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests null return when UUID does not match any attribute.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnTheOrderSetAttributeTypeWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests fetch of OrderSetAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoOrderSetAttributeTypeExistsWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when UUID is invalid for attribute type.

methods.name: purgeOrderSetAttributeType_shouldCompletelyRemoveAOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderSetAttributeType entirely.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType_shouldRetireAOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Marks an OrderSetAttributeType as retired, with reasons.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType_shouldCreateANewOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Creates and saves a new OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType_shouldEditAnExistingOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Updates an existing OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: unretireOrderSetAttributeType_shouldUnretireARetiredOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Reverts retiring an OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName_shouldGetMatchingOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Finds an attribute type by name.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName_shouldReturnNullForNonExistentName
methods.description: Returns null if attribute type name doesn’t exist.
